legal.document.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.document.privacy.body:
elo.now is a messaging app built around locally held identities and separate Spaces. This policy explains both what stays on your device and what the services you connect to need to process.

Who is responsible?

9bits sp. z o.o.
ul. Solec 81b/a51, 00-382 Warsaw, Poland

Privacy contact: elonow@9bits.com. This publisher is responsible for this website and services it operates. A company or other organization operating its own Space is responsible for its own processing. Ask that organization for its privacy information. Using the same app does not make every Space part of the same organization.

Your profile and device

You choose a name and create a local cryptographic identity. Profile information, contacts, conversation history, preferences and cryptographic material are held on your device. The local password protects your saved profile. Optional biometric unlocking uses the operating system; elo does not receive your face or fingerprint template.

Your public identity, device credential and chosen profile information are shared where needed to identify you to conversation participants and Space services. Do not send your password, recovery words or recovery QR to support.

Messages, files and Spaces

Messages are encrypted before transmission to storage servers, called Replicas. Files you choose to share are encrypted on your device before upload. Publisher-operated hosting currently uses MEGA as a separate storage provider to hold only encrypted attachment ciphertext and limited delivery metadata. Files are limited to 5 MB each and count toward a Space’s 50 MB encrypted attachment quota. Authorized participants receive the attachment key inside the signed, encrypted message record and can decrypt and save the file. Attachment bytes are not included in conversation backups. Encryption does not prevent a participant from saving, exporting or sharing what they receive.

Replicas process encrypted objects and delivery metadata, including object identifiers, sizes and timing. Servers also receive network information such as IP addresses. A Space service processes join requests, public identity and credential information, your chosen name, invitation validity and membership decisions. An optional introduction note is included with your signed join request and is visible in the owner approval queue. It is removed from that queue’s stored applicant record after a decision; short-lived replay responses may retain it for up to two minutes.

A hosted Space’s primary owner provides a contact email for membership and data requests. The address is visible to current members and is replaced when a new primary owner accepts the role with their own address. It is a contact route, not proof of identity. Creating a profile or joining as a member does not require an email address.

The General enrollment service holds an authorized participant key for its General channel. Its current role is to publish membership updates, not download conversation messages. Do not assume a channel is private from every organizational administrator.

Optional system notifications

When you enable system notifications, elo uses Google Firebase Cloud Messaging and, on Apple devices, Apple Push Notification service. These providers process installation or registration identifiers and delivery information. elo’s notification service stores the device registration and opaque routing, preference and unread-attention information needed to deliver and quiet alerts. A signed public account identifier links registrations from the same account so they can be deleted together.

Notification routing targets are encrypted. Message text and conversation names are not included in the current generic system notification payload. If you enable background incoming calls, the notification service also routes call invitations to your device; the operating system may display a call interface and process call metadata. You can disable system notifications in Settings or mute a conversation. OS settings may also control delivery.

See Firebase’s privacy information (https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy/) and Apple’s privacy policy (https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/). Their processing and international transfers must be considered alongside those of your Space operator.

App integrity and updates

Versions supporting Apple App Attest use it when registering background incoming calls on iPhone. Apple processes the attestation request. The notification service verifies the resulting proof and stores an installation key identifier, public key, replay counter and binding to the account and notification route. These records protect call registration against impersonation; they are not used for advertising and do not contain message text, biometric templates or recovery secrets. Route deletion removes its binding; unbound attestation keys become eligible for cleanup after 90 days without use.

Versions with update checking request a public release policy when the app starts, without sending a profile identifier or device credential. The server receives ordinary network information such as the IP address. The policy is cached locally and may require an update through an official download page.

Permissions

Camera access is used when you choose to scan a QR or enable video in a call. Microphone access is used for calls. Desktop screen recording is used only when you choose to share your screen. File and photo access supports the files or images you choose to open, share or save. System notifications and biometric unlocking are optional. Refusing an optional permission does not stop you using the rest of the app.

Calls

Voice and video calls use a separate call service for signaling and media delivery. Other participants can see your chosen name and media you enable during a call. Call services and network providers process connection metadata, including network addresses, timing and participation. On compatible networks, media may travel directly between participants; relays can carry media when a direct connection is unavailable. Screen sharing is available on desktop when you choose to start it. The app does not record calls for the publisher.

Backups and recovery

Recovery codes restore your identity; they are not a copy of chat history. Exported encrypted backups include supported profile and conversation data, but not attachment bytes. The backup budget is 64 MiB before encryption and compression; older message groups may be omitted to fit. The app reports omissions. You control where an exported backup or recovery QR is saved and shared.

Website, support and diagnostics

This static website uses locally hosted fonts and images. Its supplied code has no advertising, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. The web host may process normal request and security logs. If you contact support, the provider receives the contact information and material you choose to send. Avoid including unnecessary conversation content or secrets.

The app does not include advertising or an analytics dashboard. Optional diagnostic information shown by the app is not automatically a support submission.

Automatic account deletion

Encrypted content carries signed public attribution identifying its publishing account and, for shared contact or history bundles, the accounts represented in the bundle. This lets the service remove the appropriate ciphertext without reading message text. The service keeps a minimal deletion marker and authority/revocation proofs to prevent removed access or content being restored. See the account deletion instructions for the in-app action and retained-copy limitations.

Why data is processed

Profile, delivery and support information is used to provide the services you request. Permission-based features are activated at your choice. Limited security and abuse-prevention processing may be necessary to protect the services and their users. Legal obligations may require particular records to be retained. The operator of a company Space must identify its own purposes and legal bases, including employment-related processing where applicable.

Personal blocking

Blocking is a private preference for your profile on this device, across its Spaces. Blocked users’ messages and reactions are hidden, and their personal requests are dismissed. The notification service verifies the sending device’s signed identity proof and checks a recipient-owned block list; it sees sender identity during verification but not message plaintext. It stores a route-specific sender tag for policy and queued delivery. The block list is included in encrypted backups and can be managed in More → Blocked users. Other devices require their own updated preferences. Blocking does not revoke another member’s access to messages in a shared channel.

Retention and deletion

Local history remains until you remove it or the profile. Disconnecting a Space removes that Space’s local conversations and contacts from that device. Neither action erases independent copies on other devices, exported backups or every server.

The current elo notification service gives queued delivery targets and duplicate-prevention records a lifetime of up to 24 hours. Device routes expire after 30 days without renewal; deletion and housekeeping remove eligible records. Firebase and Apple have their own retention practices. Storage, membership records, operational backups and security-log retention depend on the operator and must be confirmed for the services offered by this publisher.

See account and data deletion for local removal and requests to service operators.

Your choices and rights

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of personal data, object to certain processing, or withdraw consent. Contact elonow@9bits.com for publisher-operated services, or the administrator of the relevant company Space. You may also complain to your competent data protection authority. Requests must be verified proportionately; we will not ask for your recovery secret.

International processing and changes

Your selected server location and notification providers affect where information is processed. Contact the publisher for information about the hosting location, service providers and safeguards applicable to your Space. This policy will be updated when the product or processing changes; material changes will be communicated as required.
legal.document.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.document.terms.body:
elo.now helps families, friends, communities and teams communicate in channels, direct messages and separate Spaces. These terms describe responsible use and the boundaries of a service built around participant-controlled identities.

Provider and scope

9bits sp. z o.o.
ul. Solec 81b/a51, 00-382 Warsaw, Poland

Contact: elonow@9bits.com. These terms cover services operated by the named publisher. An independently operated company Space may have additional terms supplied by its operator. Nothing here limits rights granted under applicable open-source licenses or mandatory consumer law.

Your profile

Use a name and content you are entitled to use. Protect your device, local password and recovery code. Anyone who obtains your recovery material may be able to act as you. The provider cannot reset your cryptographic identity from an email address or recover secrets it does not hold.

Use the app only if you can agree to these terms under the law that applies to you, or with the appropriate authorization of a parent, guardian or organization. The service is not designed as a children’s service.

Joining and leaving Spaces

A Space invitation may expire, be revoked or require owner approval. Joining General gives access to future conversation; it does not automatically grant earlier history. A company administrator is responsible for preparing its server and choosing who may join.

Disconnecting a Space stops local synchronization and removes its local data from that device. It is not a promise that content disappears from other participants’ devices or backups. Ask the operator about revoking server-side membership and deleting operator-held information.

Your content

You retain the rights you have in your messages and files. You authorize the processing needed to deliver, store and display them to the recipients you choose. Only share content you are permitted to share, and respect the confidentiality and rights of others.

Acceptable use

Do not use elo for unlawful activity, child sexual abuse or exploitation, threats, harassment, hate directed at protected groups, fraud, impersonation, non-consensual intimate imagery, intellectual-property infringement, spam or distribution of malware. Do not attempt unauthorized access or deliberately disrupt another person’s Space or infrastructure. See our community standards.

Report concerns to your Space administrator or elonow@9bits.com. The relevant operator may investigate, restrict access or preserve information when necessary to protect users or comply with law. You may report concerns to elonow@9bits.com; include only the information needed to investigate your report.

Availability and backups

Delivery depends on network access, recipients’ devices, configured servers and operating-system notification policies. elo is not an emergency communication service. Spaces, conversations, messages and attachments can be removed by authorized user actions, account or Space deletion, retention rules, storage limits or technical failures. Deleted or unavailable content may not be recoverable. Save recovery material and, where needed, encrypted conversation backups. A recovery code alone does not restore history. Exported backups exclude attachment bytes and may omit older messages to stay within the displayed size budget; keep separate copies of files you need to retain.

Supported versions and updates

Security and compatibility updates may be necessary to keep using connected services. We may require an update after it is available through the official download channel for your platform, with notice and a reasonable opportunity to install it, subject to applicable law. Versions that support this check show the requirement and link to the download page; they do not silently install software or delete your profile. Availability can depend on the operating system, device and store region. If your device cannot install a required update, contact support about available options before removing the app or its data. This clause does not reduce statutory rights or obligations concerning updates, service changes or remedies.

Pricing and third-party services

The elo.now app and current publisher-operated hosting are free at launch. Hosted creation is limited to two Spaces per creator identity. Each Space includes 150 MB of encrypted message storage and 50 MB of separate encrypted attachment storage; individual attachments are limited to 5 MB. There is no stated total Space-count cap; this is not a guarantee of unlimited service capacity. Any future paid offer will disclose its price and conditions before you agree to it. Your own hosting, network or platform provider may charge separately. Apple, Google and independent Space operators apply their own terms.

Ending use and data requests

You may stop using the app, remove a local profile or delete your account through More → Legal → Delete account. The deletion page explains automatic server cleanup, primary-owner requirements and the separate option to request deletion without the app. Legal duties and the rights of other participants may affect what can be erased.

No warranties

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, elo.now and publisher-operated services are provided “as is” and “as available”, without contractual warranties, whether express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, uninterrupted availability or freedom from errors. We do not guarantee that the app, encryption or hosting will be entirely secure, free from vulnerabilities, compatible with every device, or able to prevent unauthorized access, data loss or corruption. No software or encryption system can provide absolute security.

Data and continuity

You are responsible for protecting your devices, passwords and recovery material and for keeping and checking independent backups appropriate to your needs. Do not use elo.now as your only archive, emergency communication channel or a system whose failure could endanger life or health. Recovery codes alone do not restore conversation history. Backups omit attachment bytes and may omit older messages within the stated size budget. A Space owner or other authorized participant may remove a Space or content within their permissions; this may also remove access for other participants. The provider cannot promise to restore a deleted Space, conversation, message or attachment.

Limitation of liability

For business users, to the maximum extent permitted by law, 9bits sp. z o.o. excludes liability for damage arising from use of, or inability to use, the app or services, including loss, deletion, corruption or disclosure of data; loss or deletion of Spaces, conversations, messages or attachments; security incidents; delayed, missing or duplicated communications; service interruption; lost profits, revenue, business opportunities or goodwill; and the cost of replacement services or data recovery, whether the damage is direct, indirect or consequential and whether or not its possibility was known. These exclusions also cover damage caused by independent hosting providers, other participants, third-party software and loss of recovery material, to the extent such liability can lawfully be excluded.

For consumers and persons entitled to equivalent statutory protection, these exclusions apply only to the extent permitted by the mandatory law that protects them. No clause excludes or limits liability for intentional misconduct, death or personal injury where liability cannot be excluded, mandatory consumer remedies, statutory data-protection rights or any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. The free nature of the service does not remove those rights. If an exclusion is unenforceable, the applicable law governs that liability; the other provisions remain effective to the extent permitted by law.

Complaints and applicable law

Send service complaints to elonow@9bits.com. Polish law governs these terms, without depriving consumers of mandatory protections or competent courts available under the law of their habitual residence. Nothing requires consumers to waive access to a court or statutory complaint procedure.

Changes

The provider may update these terms when the service or applicable law changes. Material changes will be communicated as required. Open-source software license terms continue to apply independently.
legal.document.support.title: Support
legal.document.support.body:
A little help getting into the right conversation.

Contact support

elonow@9bits.com. Include your device model, operating-system version, app version and a short description of what happened. Never include your password, recovery words, recovery QR or private server credentials.

Join a Space

Open More → Spaces → Join a Space. Scan the invitation QR inside elo or paste its link. If approval is required, wait for the owner’s decision. Expired invitations need to be replaced by the owner.

Set up your own Space

Choose “Create a Space”, enter its name and a contact email for its primary owner, and share the invitation QR or link. The creator becomes its primary owner. Current elo hosting is free at launch and allows two Spaces per creator identity with 150 MB of encrypted message storage per Space, with a separate 50 MB attachment limit. You can also connect to a Space prepared on an independent organization’s server.

Contact support for the current deployment instructions. Keep your server credentials out of invitation emails. A QR invitation should carry the invitation link, not the administrator’s private configuration.

Restore your profile

From the sign-in menu, choose Recover. Use your recovery code or protected QR. If you also saved an encrypted backup, use the backup restore flow to bring supported history back. Your recovery code alone restores identity, not a complete archive of old conversations.

Update the app

Install updates from the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6814766127), Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=now.elo) or the desktop releases page (https://github.com/elo-now/elo-now/releases). If elo shows “Update required to go online.”, open the appropriate store or release page yourself, install the current version and reopen the app. You can still use saved chats and local features while online actions are paused. If the update is not available for your device or region, contact support. Do not uninstall the app to retry: local history may be lost. Keep your recovery material and backups safe.

Notifications

Open More → Settings and enable System notifications in the Notifications section, then allow them in your operating system. A muted chat does not produce message notifications or Buzz entries. System Focus, battery and notification settings can affect delivery. Reading a conversation allows its next unread alert to make a sound again.

Leave or remove data

Use Spaces to disconnect a Space from this device. To delete your account, remove only a saved local profile or request deletion without the app, follow the account and data deletion instructions.

Report abuse or a security issue

Contact your Space administrator or elonow@9bits.com. For a vulnerability, describe how to reproduce it using a test profile; do not include another person’s private data. For immediate danger, contact the appropriate emergency service.
legal.document.delete-account.title: Account & data deletion
legal.document.delete-account.body:
Account deletion, local profile removal and leaving a Space are different actions.

Delete your account in the app

Open the account you want to delete, then go to More → Legal → Delete account. Read the confirmation, enter your profile password and tap Delete account. No email is required. If you have no Spaces and see Create a Space / Join a Space, open Legal from the upper-right corner.

The app checks your current Spaces. If you are a primary owner with other members, open More → Spaces, tap the settings icon for that Space and use Members to transfer primary ownership. Wait for the recipient to accept. If you are the only member, use Details → Delete Space in those Space settings. Then return to Delete account.

Once the connected services accept the deletion request, the app removes saved profiles and app data for this account from this device and signs you out. Server cleanup runs automatically in the background; you do not have to keep the app open. The app retains only an opaque, read-only receipt and confirms completion when opened online. Temporary service failures can delay cleanup; accepted work retries automatically. If a service cannot be reached, the app keeps the local profile so you can retry. A request already accepted by another service continues even if a later step fails.

On supported services, deletion removes membership and application contact details, attributed message and file ciphertext, associated delivery work and push registrations. Dedicated server snapshots of affected Spaces are removed. Minimal signed authority and revocation records and a deletion marker remain to prevent deleted credentials or content being reintroduced.

Request deletion without the app

For services run by the elo.now publisher, contact elonow@9bits.com with the subject “elo.now account deletion request”. State which Space or service you used and the public Identity ID, if you have it. If you do not have that ID, describe your account so support can help identify a safe verification route. You do not need to reinstall the app.

Never send a password, recovery words, protected recovery QR or private key. Support verifies requests proportionately and explains any records that must be retained, why, and for how long.

Data in a particular Space

To contact a Space owner about particular data without deleting your whole account, select the Space and open More → Legal → Request data deletion. Use draft prepares text addressed to the current primary owner; you choose whether to send it. Each primary owner must maintain a working contact address. The incoming primary owner supplies a replacement address when accepting a transfer.

Company-operated Spaces

If another organization operates the service, its deletion endpoint and policies apply. The elo.now publisher cannot directly erase an independent operator’s infrastructure. Contact that operator if its service is unavailable or does not support automatic account deletion.

Remove a local profile

More → Recovery → Remove from this device removes only the selected local profile and its saved keys and history. Other accounts remain. Signing out or uninstalling alone does not request server-side account deletion.

Disconnect one Space

In More → Spaces, confirm Disconnect for that Space to remove its conversations and contacts from this device and stop synchronization. Your account and other Spaces remain.

What can remain?

Other participants and offline devices may retain previously received messages. Files or backups saved outside elo and copies held by independent parties cannot be remotely erased. Old backups do not restore revoked access to our services. Additional operator-held support or legally required records follow the privacy policy and applicable retention obligations; contact elonow@9bits.com about those records.
legal.document.community.title: Community standards
legal.document.community.body:
A Space should be somewhere people can talk, plan and work together without harassment or abuse.

What is not allowed

Do not share child sexual abuse material, facilitate child exploitation or grooming, threaten people, encourage violence, harass or bully others, or promote hatred against protected groups. Non-consensual intimate imagery, impersonation, scams, malware, spam and unlawful content are prohibited. Respect intellectual property and other people’s confidential information.

Block a user

Use “Block user” from a message’s menu or Contacts to hide that person’s messages, reactions and direct requests on this device. Manage or undo blocks in More → Blocked users. Notification protection takes effect when the device confirms its updated policy with the notification service. Blocking does not remove a member from a shared Space; report abuse separately so its owner or operator can act.

Report a concern

Contact your Space administrator or elonow@9bits.com. Identify the Space, the user or content involved and the approximate time. Share only the evidence you choose and are entitled to disclose; do not send recovery secrets. If someone is in immediate danger, contact emergency services.

Protecting children

Child sexual abuse and exploitation are prohibited in every form. Do not circulate illegal material to report it. Provide a description or lawful reference and contact the relevant authorities where appropriate. Send child-safety concerns to elonow@9bits.com without forwarding illegal material. The publisher reviews reports and may refer suspected criminal activity to the competent authorities as required by law.

Operator responsibilities

Company Space operators are responsible for responding to reports, enforcing their membership policies and complying with applicable law. For publisher-operated services, send reports to elonow@9bits.com. Encryption is not an excuse to ignore a report made by a participant.

Enforcement

The responsible operator may investigate reports, restrict access and cooperate with lawful requests. Measures should be proportionate and respect the rights of those involved. Contact support if you believe an action was mistaken.
